intended_object: Given a split epimorphism f : X ⟶ S with chosen section s and any g : T ⟶ S, the induced section of the pulled-back map pullback.snd f g : X ×_S T ⟶ T, namely the map with components (g ≫ s, 𝟙 T). This is the stability of split epis under pullback, inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The section is pullback.lift (g ≫ s) (𝟙 T). It is well defined because (g ≫ s) ≫ f = g = 𝟙 T ≫ g, using s ≫ f = 𝟙 S. The splitting identity section_ ≫ pullback.snd f g = 𝟙 T is pullback.lift_snd. Both projections match the docstring. The construction is stated for an arbitrary category and only assumes that this one pullback exists, which is its natural generality. Mathlib has only the special cases that pullback.fst f f and pullback.snd f f are split epis (in Limits/Shapes/Diagonal.lean), not this general construction.
